text:
rachel: Quick sync: proposing a "warmup-credit" concept layered on top of existing burst credits. Purpose: isolate actions that actually allocate GPUs (start VM, load weights).

omar: Why a separate credit type vs tagging existing bursts?

rachel: Two reasons: (1) billing clarity (we can show warmup usage separately), (2) different refill semantics so long-running traffic can't deplete warmup pool.

vega: Config sketch?

rachel: Minimal example:
```yaml
autoscale:
  mode: mixed
  warmup_credit:
    seed: 2
    refill_per_hour: 1
    cap: 12
  predictive:
    window: 8m
  reactive:
    tail_ms: 300
```

nate: Ops ask: who pays while a prewarm is pulling model data? tenant or infra?

rachel: Proposal: predictive prewarms are treated like reservations (tenant pays). Reactive prewarms are drawn from a subsidized pool per plan; over-cap usage triggers billing.

omar: Subsidy limits need to be per-tier. Also operator should be able to reject predictive reservations if cluster headroom low.

vega: Operator surface idea: AdmitRequest with fields required_gpus, warmup_credit_estimate, model_id, ttl_s. Operator returns admit/deny/retry + reason code. Supports dry_run. Example: {tenant: "acme", required_gpus: 1, warmup_credit_estimate: 1, model_id: "m-42"}.

rachel: Add prewarm TTL and expected_model_hash to reduce wasted pulls when model rotates. Also auto-release leases after TTL expiry.

ops-bot: note: dry_run endpoint merged to staging. Returns estimated_cost and prewarm_time_s. Canary 2% tenants so far.

nate: Metrics list to add: warmup_credits_spent_total, warmup_refills, predictive_prewarms, reactive_prewarms, prewarm_failures. Alert when predictive_prewarms > 50% cluster_headroom.

omar: Rollout: opt-in tenants -> small canary -> tiered enable. Operator kill-switch required for predictive scheduling.

vega: Edge case: partial prewarm (weight stream interrupted). Plan: operator emits prewarm_failure and refund policy for short-lived failures. Keep refund window small.

rachel: Next step: I'll draft a short RFC addendum with admit proto sketch, config schema, PromQL examples, and rollout checklist. Will ping for review. :rocket:
